verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a connections/integrations framework (Understanding Connections, Custom Connections API) and a read-only device agent (drata-gh-1/2/3) supporting evidence collection across systems, plus API endpoints for devices, personnel, controls. However, the evidence pack lacks an explicit named catalog enumerating specific cloud/IdP/HR/code-hosting/MDM/ticketing integrations or independent verification of read-only scoping across all categories. Missing for 10: a documented integrations catalog listing specific supported systems per category, and independent/hands-on confirmation of read-only scopes across the full stack.
